sources.primary_title: Saudi Digital Exhibition to Showcase Government Experiences at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: The Saudi Digital Government Authority (DGA) announced on August 25, 2026, that it will organize the Saudi Digital Exhibition at LEAP 2026. The exhibition will feature more than 20 launches of government digital products and platforms. Additionally, over 30 agreements and MoUs will be signed among government entities, private-sector companies, and international organizations. The event aims to showcase the Kingdom's achievements in digital transformation and the progress of the Saudi digital ecosystem. The exhibition will also host more than 15 panel discussions covering AI, emerging technologies, smart cities, and cybersecurity, providing a concrete operational update for TechScoop Desk coverage without duplicating existing broad LEAP 2026 announcements.
